verdict.rationale: Canny's Autopilot is documented as automatically capturing feedback from support, sales, and review platforms. Named sources cover sales calls (Gong, Fathom and Fireflies transcripts) and chat (Intercom, Slack), so all three channels in the story are claimed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality, specific named support-ticketing integrations and detailed docs on how Autopilot extracts and dedupes feedback.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically capture customer feedback mentioned in sales calls, support tickets, and chat conversations
